description: Three coupled chat-surface features: Fork-from-here on assistant messages, Export format picker + Tauri save dialog, honest Share. Built as one coherent surface.

gates.vitest: Test Files 11 passed / Tests 120 passed (baseline 9 files / 105)

verification.fork_button_assistant_only: MessageActions renders Fork on assistant when onFork+canFork; never user/system/tool (7 tests)
verification.export_flow: ChatView opens format picker -> save dialog -> exportToHtml/exportToJsonl(path); honest toast (4 tests)
verification.share_honest: runCommand('share') success -> 'Session shared'; failure -> real error; no 'Share not available yet' (2 tests)
verification.fork_wiring: ChatView onFork calls forkSession(message.id) + reload + toast (2 tests)
verification.palette_decoupled: export/share commands dispatch sophos:request-export / sophos:request-share; ChatView subscribes via useEffect; buildPaletteCommands signature unchanged

reflection: Fork glyph mirrors sessions ForkIcon path at 12px/strokeWidth 1.8/currentColor to match Copy/Edit/Retry
Export/share IPC + toast ownership kept in ChatView via custom window events, avoiding App.tsx / buildPaletteCommands signature churn
Added reload() to useTranscript/useChat so a fork actually navigates to the new session's transcript
save dialog guarded by isTauri (browser preview exports to default path); tests mock @tauri-apps/plugin-dialog + ipc/client with isTauri true
Fork button reuses .message-action-btn CSS; only added .export-picker styles
